verdict: Revision required. curriculum_v2 repairs the explicit coverage, prerequisite, prior boundary, and SQL-generation defects in review_v1, and all 19 internal nodes have coherent synthesis probes. It still has two blocking cross-branch boundary collisions and three composite leaves with weak mutual confidence. No held-out evaluation probe applies to C06, so evaluation-backed coverage and mapping remain insufficient rather than successful.
blocking_findings: Boundary failure between `c06.schema_constraints` and `c06.data_quality_controls`: the counterexample task "validate supplied order records against required-field, type, and range constraints and quarantine invalid rows" matches both sections. Its decisive operation is explicit record-constraint validation; quarantine is only a delivery wrapper and cannot establish membership under the rubric. `c06.data_quality_controls` should concentrate on batch uniqueness, cross-record/reference checks, reconciliation, anomaly thresholds, and acceptance decisions, or explicitly consume schema-validation results produced elsewhere.

Boundary failure between `c06.complex_document_integration` and `c06.record_linkage`: both claim entity resolution across heterogeneous records. The counterexample task "reconcile `Western Mich.`, `WMU`, and `Western Michigan` rows across standings, recruiting, and schedule tables before building one season dataset" fits both sections based on the same decisive identity-resolution operation. `c06.complex_document_integration` should consume already resolved identities or exclude uncertain matching and survivorship; otherwise the source-document versus pipeline-feed distinction is merely a narrative wrapper.

Mutual-confidence failures remain in `c06.query_composition`, `c06.record_linkage`, and `c06.distributed_write_coordination`. Their counterexample pairs and required splits are detailed under `mutual_confidence_findings`. The `c06.distributed_write_coordination` representative also cannot guarantee full-outcome exercise because a solution may choose one coordination mechanism without demonstrating atomic commit, saga compensation, and conflict resolution.
mutual_confidence_findings: `c06.query_composition` fails the composite-leaf test. Mastery of a correlated `NOT EXISTS` or above-group-average subquery organized through CTEs would not predict correct use of `UNION ALL`, `INTERSECT`, and `EXCEPT` with deliberate duplicate semantics to reconcile current and archived populations. These are distinct central SQL operations; split set operations from subquery/CTE composition.

`c06.record_linkage` fails the composite-leaf test. Mastery of blocking, fuzzy similarity, threshold calibration, and false-merge control for deciding which rows co-refer would not predict success when already-linked clusters are supplied and the task is to select surviving names, addresses, and dates using source authority, recency, temporal validity, and provenance. Matching and survivorship should be separate leaves under a synthesis parent.

`c06.distributed_write_coordination` fails the composite-leaf test. Mastery of consensus-backed atomic commit for a cross-shard balance transfer would not predict success designing saga compensation and deterministic conflict resolution for concurrently edited, intermittently connected multi-region records; the mechanisms, failure contracts, and bodies of knowledge differ. Split atomic distributed transactions from asynchronous compensation/conflict handling.

The eight review_v1 composite defects were substantially repaired: `c06.json_yaml_serialization` became `c06.json_serialization` and `c06.yaml_serialization`; `c06.joins_and_aggregates` became `c06.join_queries` and `c06.grouped_aggregation`; `c06.analytical_sql` became `c06.query_composition`, `c06.window_analytics`, and `c06.recursive_queries`; `c06.data_cleaning` was narrowed and `c06.record_linkage` added; `c06.pipeline_monitoring_recovery` became `c06.pipeline_monitoring` and `c06.pipeline_recovery`; `c06.keyvalue_widecolumn_modeling` became `c06.key_value_modeling` and `c06.wide_column_modeling`; `c06.partitioning_replication` became `c06.data_partitioning` and `c06.replica_topology`; and `c06.consistency_transactions` became `c06.replicated_read_consistency` and `c06.distributed_write_coordination`. The three residual failures above show that two replacement leaves remain composite and one additional composite leaf remains too broad.
continuity_findings: Passes: `c06.schema_constraints -> c06.grounded_record_mapping`. Both probes require a full audit of structural, scalar, array, and nullability constraints; the dependent representative must satisfy every constraint. The single entry delta is mapping one explicitly supported fact into the audited record.

Passes: `c06.schema_constraints -> c06.schema_instance_generation`. The entry first audits nested types, enums, bounds, arrays, and nullability, and the representative validates every applicable rule. The single entry delta is generating one coherent missing value rather than judging supplied values.

Passes: `c06.grounded_record_mapping -> c06.complex_document_integration`. The entry performs complete prose-to-schema mapping before adding one matching table row, and the representative maps an overview before reconciling several related tables. The single new operation is cross-source entity and relationship reconciliation.

Passes: `c06.transactional_mutation -> c06.concurrency_control`. The entry first implements an atomic, rollback-safe, idempotent reservation transaction and then adds one optimistic-version predicate. The representative likewise requires full mutations before analyzing competing interleavings; concurrency control is the single new operation.

Passes: `c06.statement_observability -> c06.integrity_failure_diagnosis`. The entry requires complete capture of SQL, parameters, timing, transaction context, correlation identity, and outcome before identifying the violated constraint. The representative uses the same capture to diagnose implicit and concurrent causes; causal diagnosis is the single new operation.

All five curriculum_v2 prerequisite edges were checked. The eleven failing review_v1 edges were removed, while the five retained edges now place the prerequisite's full outcome in both dependent probes rather than merely consuming a completed artifact.
other_findings: Coverage repairs are present. `c06.query_performance_diagnosis` now covers plans, estimates, statistics, join choices, spills, regressions, and justified tuning. `c06.schema_migrations`, `c06.backup_restore_recovery`, and `c06.schema_evolution` cover the previously missing database migration, recovery, and changing-contract capabilities.

The two explicit review_v1 boundary defects are repaired. `c06.key_value_modeling` and `c06.wide_column_modeling` now own logical access paths while `c06.data_partitioning` owns physical shards and rebalancing. `c06.logical_schema_design`, `c06.data_quality_controls`, and `c06.integrity_failure_diagnosis` now distinguish database-enforced invariants, pipeline acceptance controls, and diagnosis of an observed runtime failure.

The review_v1 SQL generation defects are repaired. The `c06.sql_querying` representative now exercises recursion, set combination, joins, aggregation, windows, a CTE, null semantics, and duplicate semantics in one query. The former `c06.analytical_sql` scope is represented by separate full probes in `c06.query_composition`, `c06.window_analytics`, and `c06.recursive_queries`.

All 19 internal-node representatives were checked: `c06.databases_data_engineering`, `c06.structured_data`, `c06.schema_governed_records`, `c06.format_serialization`, `c06.relational_databases`, `c06.sql_querying`, `c06.relational_schema_design`, `c06.reliable_data_changes`, `c06.database_operations`, `c06.database_lifecycle`, `c06.data_pipelines`, `c06.data_ingestion`, `c06.transformation_quality`, `c06.pipeline_orchestration`, `c06.analytical_delivery`, `c06.nosql_graph_data`, `c06.nonrelational_models`, `c06.graph_data`, and `c06.distributed_data_systems`. Each combines its immediate children around one natural record set, query, incident, deployment, pipeline, analytical model, service, graph, or distributed dataset rather than concatenating unrelated deliverables.

Guidepost coverage is explicit: C06.1 maps to `c06.sql_querying`, `c06.relational_schema_design`, `c06.reliable_data_changes`, `c06.database_operations`, and `c06.database_lifecycle`; C06.2 maps to `c06.data_pipelines`; C06.3 maps principally to `c06.transformation_quality`; and C06.5 maps to `c06.nonrelational_models`, `c06.graph_data`, and `c06.distributed_data_systems`. This is guidepost-backed design coverage, not held-out validation.

All 16 discovery tasks were accounted for by primary capability: `c06-d01` -> `c06.grounded_record_mapping` but underdetermined; `c06-d02` -> `c06.connection_configuration`; `c06-d03` -> `c06.grounded_record_mapping`; `c06-d04` -> `c06.integrity_failure_diagnosis`; `c06-d05` -> `c06.xml_serialization` but underdetermined; `c06-d06` -> `c06.grounded_record_mapping`; `c06-d07` -> `c06.csv_reshaping`; `c06-d08` -> `c06.grounded_record_mapping`; `c06-d09` -> `c06.schema_instance_generation`; `c06-d10` -> `c06.schema_instance_generation`; `c06-d11` -> `c06.grounded_record_mapping`; `c06-d12` -> `c06.grounded_record_mapping` but answer-contaminated; `c06-d13` and `c06-d14` -> `c06.grounded_record_mapping`; and `c06-d15` and `c06-d16` -> `c06.complex_document_integration`, with `c06-d16` contaminated. Fourteen tasks remain concentrated in schema-governed extraction, generation, integration, or serialization; only `c06-d02` and `c06-d04` directly support database operations, and none directly supports SQL, pipelines, warehousing, NoSQL, graph, or distributed-system granularity.

Evidence-quality defects from review_v1 remain because the discovery set is unchanged: `c06-d01` and `c06-d05` require absent values without clear authorization to invent them; `c06-d12` exposes a supplied CSV answer before requesting JSON; and `c06-d16` contains unrelated Andros schema/answer material before the Mission Creek task. These examples cannot count as clean positive anchors.

None of the 15 rows in `eval_probes_manifest.jsonl` includes C06 in `applicable_subject_ids`; therefore the corresponding 15 annotations provide zero applicable held-out evaluations. Coverage, routing stability, close-negative boundaries, and retrieval quality for C06 remain unsupported by direct evaluation evidence. Their absence is insufficient evidence, not evidence of success.

Structural checks pass: curriculum_v2 has 64 sections, 19 internal nodes, 45 leaves, five valid prerequisite edges, exactly one entry and one representative probe per section, no missing parent or prerequisite IDs, and no duplicate probe instructions.
rubric_changes: No rubric change is required for this audit. The existing decisive-operation boundary test, composite-leaf counterexample test, prerequisite artifact-falsification test, and evidence-adequacy rule expose the remaining defects.
